description: This PHP file defines the class TemplateRelatedTextField, which extends TemplateText, and includes methods for rendering HTML components, managing related data, and handling dynamic field operations within the context of SuiteCRM. It specifically manages related text fields, including their display, search, editing, and database alterations, functioning as part of the dynamic fields module.

classes.name: TemplateRelatedTextField
classes.description: A class managing related text fields in SuiteCRM, providing methods for rendering HTML, managing related data, and integrating with dynamic field setup and deletion procedures.

methods.name: get_html_edit
methods.description: Generates HTML for editing the related text field, including a readonly input display and a button to open a popup for selection.

methods.name: get_html_detail
methods.description: Returns HTML for displaying the related record as a hyperlink to its detail view.

methods.name: get_html_list
methods.description: Generates list view representation of the related field, referencing the object and field name.

methods.name: get_html_search
methods.description: Provides HTML for search input, including support for multi-select filters if available.

methods.name: get_xtpl_search
methods.description: Returns array with data for search templates, including popup request data encoding and team filtering.

methods.name: get_xtpl_edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing interface, including popup request data and loading related record labels.

methods.name: get_xtpl_detail
methods.description: Returns template data for detailed view, delegating to get_xtpl_edit.

methods.name: get_related_info
methods.description: Placeholder for retrieving related info; currently empty.

methods.name: get_field_def
methods.description: Retrieves the field definition array, augmented with related module info and labels, for use in form and studio integrations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the related ID field and label, supporting DynamicField and MBModule types.

methods.name: deleteIdLabel
methods.description: Removes label entries for the ID field across language files and modules.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the related ID field and its label, creating new ID fields if necessary.

methods.name: saveIdLabel
methods.description: Creates or updates label entries for the ID field in module language files.

methods.name: get_db_add_alter_table
methods.description: Returns empty string, indicating no specific add/alter table SQL.

methods.name: get_db_delete_alter_table
methods.description: Returns empty string, indicating no specific delete table SQL.

methods.name: get_db_modify_alter_table
methods.description: Returns empty string, indicating no specific modify table SQL.
